entities.summary: Patrick Ebosele Ekpu was a Nigerian prelate of the Catholic Church. He served as archbishop of the Archdiocese of Benin City from 1994 to 2006, having elevated from bishop of that city in which he served from 1973 to 1994. He also served as Titular Bishop of Castabala from 1971 to 1973. He helped in many catholic projects.
